---
title: "Recurrence supplement integration and reader PDF"
format: html
---

Historical builder, superseded for submission on 2026-09-25 by
`manuscript/supplementary_information_accepted.qmd`, which retains the author's
accepted captions, front matter and current table references. Do not regenerate
the submission supplement from the September 23 snapshot below.

Build the historical reader PDF from a verified preview of the live supplementary document.
The preview renders suggestions without accepting them. Preserve the author's
caption wording, use one figure per page, and keep titles and panel letters bold.
No statistical analysis is rerun. The JSON snapshot and all outputs live outside Git.

```{python}
import json,re,html,hashlib,urllib.request
raise RuntimeError('Historical snapshot blocked: use manuscript/supplementary_information_accepted.qmd')
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from reportlab.platypus import Paragraph
from reportlab.lib.styles import ParagraphStyle
from reportlab.pdfbase import pdfmetrics
from reportlab.pdfbase.ttfonts import TTFont
from pypdf import PdfReader

out=Path('/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569/derived/recurrence_supplement_2026-09-23')
d=json.loads((out/'supp_after_preview.json').read_text())
pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont('SuppArial','/System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental/Arial.ttf'))
pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont('SuppBold','/System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental/Arial Bold.ttf'))
pdfmetrics.registerFontFamily('SuppArial',normal='SuppArial',bold='SuppBold',italic='SuppArial',boldItalic='SuppBold')
style=ParagraphStyle('Caption',fontName='SuppArial',fontSize=10,leading=13)
items=[];pending=[];refs=[];inrefs=False
for b in d['body']['content']:
 elements=b.get('paragraph',{}).get('elements',[])
 pending += [e['inlineObjectElement']['inlineObjectId'] for e in elements if 'inlineObjectElement' in e]
 text=''.join(e.get('textRun',{}).get('content','') for e in elements).strip()
 if text.startswith('Figure S'):
  assert len(pending)==1,(text[:50],pending)
  items.append((int(re.match(r'Figure S(\d+):',text)[1]),text,pending.pop()))
 elif text=='References':inrefs=True
 elif inrefs and text:refs.append(text)
assert [x[0] for x in items]==list(range(1,10)),items
assert not pending,pending
W,H=595.28,841.89
c=canvas.Canvas(str(out/'Supplementary_Figures.pdf'),pagesize=(W,H))
manifest=[]
for n,caption,oid in items:
 uri=d['inlineObjects'][oid]['inlineObjectProperties']['embeddedObject']['imageProperties']['contentUri']
 path=out/f'Supplementary_Figure_S{n}_live.png'
 if not path.exists():
  with urllib.request.urlopen(uri,timeout=60) as r:path.write_bytes(r.read())
 iw,ih=Image.open(path).size
 title_end=caption.index('.')+1
 body=html.escape(caption[title_end:].strip()).replace('₂','<sub>2</sub>')
 body=re.sub(r'\b([A-Z])\)',r'<b>\1)</b>',body)
 p=Paragraph('<b>'+html.escape(caption[:title_end])+'</b> '+body,style)
 _,ch=p.wrap(W-72,H-72)
 avail=H-72-ch-14
 scale=min((W-72)/iw,avail/ih)
 pw,ph=iw*scale,ih*scale
 c.drawImage(str(path),(W-pw)/2,H-36-ph,width=pw,height=ph)
 p.drawOn(c,36,H-36-ph-14-ch)
 c.setFont('SuppArial',8);c.drawString(36,22,'Supplementary figures');c.drawRightString(W-36,22,str(n));c.showPage()
 manifest.append({'figure':f'S{n}','caption':caption,'image':str(path),'image_sha256':hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'display_width_pt':pw,'display_height_pt':ph,'caption_height_pt':ch})
if refs:
 c.setFont('SuppBold',12);c.drawString(36,H-40,'References');y=H-65
 for ref in refs:
  p=Paragraph(html.escape(ref),style);_,rh=p.wrap(W-72,H-72);assert y-rh>36
  p.drawOn(c,36,y-rh);y-=rh+14
 c.setFont('SuppArial',8);c.drawString(36,22,'Supplementary figures');c.drawRightString(W-36,22,'10');c.showPage()
c.save()
reader=PdfReader(out/'Supplementary_Figures.pdf');assert len(reader.pages)==9+bool(refs)
for i,p in enumerate(reader.pages[:9]):assert f'Figure S{i+1}:' in p.extract_text()
(out/'figure_manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps({'figures':manifest,'references':refs,'source':'live supplementary Google Doc, suggestions-preview snapshot','pdf_sha256':hashlib.sha256((out/'Supplementary_Figures.pdf').read_bytes()).hexdigest()},indent=2))
print('Built',len(reader.pages),'pages: S1-S9 plus references.')
```
